gsod<N>: Daily station weather observations: one row per station-day (keys stn, wban, year, mo, da) with measures temp, count_temp, dewp, count_dewp, slp, count_slp, stp, count_stp, visib, count_visib, wdsp, count_wdsp, mxpsd, gust, max, flag_max, min, flag_min, prcp, flag_prcp, sndp and binary weather indicators fog, rain_drizzle, snow_ice_pellets, hail, thunder, tornado_funnel_cloud.
stations: Weather station inventory: one row per station (keys usaf, wban) with attributes name, country, state, call, lat, lon, elev, begin, end.
